decisions.reason: As a close-to-core cheese that remained visible after launch, it likely performed at or above aspiration levels and is inexpensive to support with the firm's existing cheese capabilities.

Although a spicy multi-variant line adds some assortment complexity, its continued dedicated presentation suggests satisfactory results, so management would usually retain it absent a clear performance shortfall.

This soft cheese looks somewhat more marginal than the harder-cheese extensions and the firm already dropped a related soft-cheese launch, but surviving beyond launch still points to acceptable performance and enough slack to keep it.
